name: madani
description: Madani (مداني): read and record your camel herd's reproduction from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
مداني هو تطبيق ملّاك الإبل لمتابعة التناسل: المناخ، وفحص الحمل، والولادة، ونقل الأجنة، والنسب. بعد ربط حسابك في مداني تستطيع أن تسأل ChatGPT عن حلالك بلغتك، كتابةً أو بالصوت: كم ناقة مدني، ومتى تلد ناقة معيّنة، وما آخر مناخ لها. وتستطيع أن تسجّل الأحداث اليومية: مناخ، فحص حمل، ولادة مع اسم الحوار، نتيجة مناخ، جدولة مناخ، نقل أجنة، إضافة إبل، تعديل بيانات ناقة، أو تحديد أبيها وأمها.

لا يُحفظ شيء بكلام المحادثة وحده: كل تسجيل يظهر في بطاقة تراجعها وتعدّلها، ولا يُحفظ إلا حين تضغط «حفظ» بنفسك. وإذا لم يُعرف الاسم بالضبط (كأن يُسمع «سيته» بدل «صيتة») تعرض البطاقة أقرب الأسماء في حلالك لتختار منها، ولا تختار عنك. لا يمكن من ChatGPT حذف ناقة ولا نقل ملكيتها ولا أي عملية مالية. تسري صلاحيات حسابك كما هي في التطبيق، ولا يرى أحد غيرك بياناتك.

Madani is the camel owners' app for reproduction records: matings, pregnancy checks, births, embryo transfer and pedigree. Once you connect your Madani account you can ask ChatGPT about your herd, by text or by voice, and record everyday events. Every write is shown on a card you review, and nothing is saved until you press «حفظ» yourself. When a spoken name is not found exactly, the card offers the closest names in your herd for you to choose. Deleting camels, transferring ownership and anything involving payment are not available from ChatGPT. You need a Madani account (sign in with your phone number).
defaultPrompt: كم ناقة في حلالي، وكم منها مدني؟
من الناقة التي ستلد قريبًا في حلالي؟

publication.release_notes: First release of Madani in ChatGPT. Read the herd (a summary by reproductive state, one camel's card with pregnancy progress and expected delivery) and record everyday reproduction events (mating, pregnancy check, birth with the calf's name, mating outcome, scheduled mating, embryo transfer, adding camels, editing a camel's profile, setting its father or mother). Every write goes through a card and is saved only when the user presses «حفظ». Names that were misheard by voice are matched to the closest names in the user's herd and offered for the user to choose. Pregnant camels are labelled مدني on the camel card.

review.commerce_description: The plugin involves no purchases, payments or subscriptions.

positive.description: Herd summary. Sign in with the reviewer account (its herd: وضحى and غزالة pregnant, صيتة mated and awaiting a check, الجازي and مزنة open, the bull شاهين, the young female ريم).
positive.prompt: كم ناقة في حلالي، وكم منها مدني؟
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from the tool only: 7 head in total; النوق by state — 2 مدني (وضحى، غزالة), 1 متنوخة (صيتة), 2 حايل (الجازي، مزنة); the rest of the herd by life stage (the bull, the young female); وضحى listed among births expected within 30 days. No images, no web results.

Shows the camel card for وضحى: state مدني, days pregnant and days left with a progress bar, the expected delivery date, the latest mating and its bull (شاهين), and recent events. The text reply is one or two sentences and does not restate the card.

positive.description: Record a mating through a card; nothing is saved until the reviewer presses «حفظ».
positive.prompt: سجّل مناخ الجازي من شاهين اليوم
positive.expected_behavior: prepare_mating shows the mating card with الجازي, the bull شاهين from the reviewer's own bulls, today's date and natural method, and says nothing is saved yet. Only after the reviewer presses «حفظ» on the card does commit_mating save it; the card then confirms the mating and الجازي becomes متنوخة. If the case is run a second time the card warns that الجازي already has a mating awaiting a check.

positive.description: Record a pregnancy check through a card.
positive.expected_behavior: prepare_pregnancy_diagnosis shows a card for صيتة linked to her pending mating with شاهين, method ultrasound, result pregnant, today's date. After the reviewer presses «حفظ» the card confirms and صيتة becomes مدني with an expected delivery date 380 days after the mating.

positive.description: A name misheard by voice. «سيته» is how a transcript hears «صيتة»; no camel in the herd has that exact name.
positive.expected_behavior: find_camels finds no exact match for «سيته» and returns the closest name in the reviewer's herd, صيتة; her camel card then opens (state, pregnancy progress, recent events). No other camel is opened and no camel is invented. Run it in a new chat so earlier messages do not supply the name.

negative.description: Deleting a camel is not available from ChatGPT. The assistant should explain that this is done in the Madani app, call no Madani write tool, and not claim anything was deleted.
Transferring a camel's ownership is not available from ChatGPT. The assistant should say so and point to the Madani app, without calling any Madani write tool.
A general camel question that is not about the user's herd. The assistant should answer from general knowledge without calling any Madani tool.
